tasks.description: Implement logic to calculate and display discounted prices. Original prices are rendered with text-decoration: line-through if a discount is present.
acceptance_criteria: 'GET /api/cars' must serialize seeded 'discount_percentage' values as numeric fields.
'POST /api/cars' must persist 'discount_percentage' as integer 15 when the create request body contains 'discount_percentage': 15.
'POST /api/cars' must persist 'discount_percentage' as 0 when the create request body omits the 'discount_percentage' property.
'PUT /api/cars/:id' must persist 'discount_percentage' as integer 25 when the update request body contains 'discount_percentage': 25.
'GET /api/cars' must include the persisted 'discount_percentage' property in every serialized car object.
'GET /api/cars/:id' must include the persisted 'discount_percentage' property in the serialized car object.
'AddCarPage' must render the 'Discount (%)' number input with id='car-discount-input' in Step 3 'Registration & Details' immediately after the 'Price' input.
'EditCarPage' must render the 'Discount (%)' number input with id='car-discount-input' and pre-fill it from the car's persisted 'discount_percentage' value.
'CarCard' must render a discount badge with text '15% OFF' for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 15.
'CarCard' must render the discounted price for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 15.
'CarCard' must render the original price as a line-through value for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 15.
'CarDetailsPage' Overview tab must render a discount badge with text '15% OFF' for a seeded API car response with 'discount_percentage': 15.
'CarDetailsPage' Price tab must render 'Festival Discount (15%)' for a seeded new car API response with 'condition': 'New' and 'discount_percentage': 15.
'CarDetailsPage' Price tab must render 'Special Offer Discount (15%)' for a seeded used car API response with 'condition': 'Used' and 'discount_percentage': 15.
'PurchaseModal' must render the final discounted price for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 15.
'PurchaseModal' must render an 'Offer' value of '15% OFF' for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 15.
'CarCard' must not render a discount badge for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 0.
'CarCard' must not render an original line-through price for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 0.
'CarDetailsPage' Overview tab must not render a discount badge for a seeded API car response with 'discount_percentage': 0.
'PurchaseModal' must not render the 'Offer' section for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage': 0.
'CarCard' must render the original price, not a discounted price, when 'discount_percentage' is 100.
'CarDetailsPage' Overview tab must render the original acquisition price, not a discounted price, when 'discount_percentage' is -10.
'PurchaseModal' must render the original price and must not render an 'Offer' section when 'discount_percentage' is 100.
